---
name: Missing model or feature
about: A diffusion model family, scheduler, adapter or pipeline feature brodiffusion does not support
labels: enhancement
---

**What is missing:** the model (Hugging Face repo id and diffusers pipeline
class), scheduler, adapter (LoRA, ControlNet, ...) or feature.

**What needs it:** the app or library that would use it, and the resolution
and backend you want to run it on.
